name: create-presentation
description: Create a new Keynote presentation with a theme and set the title slide text

steps.script:
tell application "Keynote"
    -- Create a new presentation with a theme
    set newDoc to make new document with properties {document theme: theme id "[TOKEN_REDACTED]" of application "Keynote"}
    tell newDoc
        tell slide 1
            set object text of default title item to "New Presentation"
            set object text of default body item to "Created via automation"
        end tell
    end tell
    set docName to name of newDoc
    -- Close it to demonstrate the workflow
    close newDoc saving no
    return "Created: " & docName
end tell
steps.description:
AppleScript: tell application "Keynote"
    -- Create a new presentation with a theme
    set...
